A user can follow other users and have other users following them thus creating a vibrant community. Users can have people liking and commenting on their post, increasing engagement and creating a vibrant hair community.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Jonah and Joe first met as teen tech YouTubers in 2008 and began building iPhone apps together in 2009. At the end of 2024, we started Mixy as a fun way for fans to make mashups of their favorite songs.

We publicly iterated prototypes on TikTok, which led to over 350k pre-orders before launch. Mixy debuted on June 19th, hitting #1 in Music and reaching #3 overall in the App Store. Since then, more than 1.5M users have created and shared over 15M mashups.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Derivative musical works are being created at an exponential rate, but artists aren’t getting credited, and billions of dollars are being left on the table.

Every year, millions of songs are uploaded to music platforms with uncredited samples. Generative AI has accelerated this problem: music is being trained on artists’ work and re-uploaded without attribution, ownership, or financial stake for the creators who made it possible.

Mixy flips this model. We celebrate artists by letting fans directly manipulate and share versions of their songs. Every time a fan shares their creation, the artist is automatically credited and their work is distributed more widely. Because Mixy owns the creation layer, attribution is native. We auto-credit every source track and pair it with a music-first social network built for playback and discovery.

The future isn’t millions of disconnected AI songs or samples, it’s millions of recognizable songs evolving through thousands of shared versions.

We’re tackling this because we love music, see a timely problem, and bring a world-class background in creative tools and consumer social.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
If we truly succeed, Mixy will be the platform that redefines music in the age of derivative works. What TikTok is to YouTube, Mixy is to music.

We’ll be the first to establish proper licensing and attribution standards for a future where songs constantly evolve into new versions. Every derivative creation, whether a mashup, remix, AI-generated variation, or fan edit, will flow back to the original artist with automatic credit and revenue.

Music expression and consumption will no longer be limited to static recordings. Instead, the world will experience songs as living, evolving works. Fans will become co-creators, artists will be celebrated more widely than ever, and the industry will unlock billions in new value.

In this future, music is not just listened to. It’s played with, passed around, and endlessly reinterpreted, with artists always at the center.

⁕ #1 in Music and #3 Top Free overall on the App Store

⁕ 1.5M users in 3 months

⁕ 18M mashups made and growing

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95158&key=user_uploads/42474/cd3aa913-8172-4a48-a472-4d21f4e03eb8)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-W_6p6g2CdE

**What’s Next?**

⁕ Instantly enable people to create full length mashups and remixes through our own music mixing model

⁕ Create the best listening experience where all of your favorite songs combine and blend into one another in unimaginable ways

⁕ Instantly pay out artists and creators per second on plays

⁕ The music industry will unlock billions in value and Mixy will change how we experience music forever

**Our Story**

Joe and Jonah met as tech YouTubers in 2008, and began building apps together in 2009. They’ve worked at Apple, Instagram, and Skillshare. Recently Jonah led mobile at Tithly (Stripe’s 8th largest customers), and Joe founded a consumer social startup acquired by CoinList ($100M Series A), where he led product.

At the end of 2024, we started Mixy was started as a fun way for fans to make mashups of their favorite songs. Prototypes were shared on TikTok, which led to over 350k pre-orders before launch. Mixy debuted on June 19th, hitting #1 in Music and reaching #3 overall in the App Store. Since then, more than 1.5M users have created and shared over 18M mashups.

---

**Problem & Vision**

We believe Remixing is the new Shuffle.

Fans are searching for infinite ways to experience their favorite artists, and the tools to remix and create derivatives are far too complicated.

For artists, derivative musical works are being created at an exponential rate, but artists aren’t getting credited, and billions of dollars are being left on the table.

Mixy flips this model. We celebrate artists by letting fans directly manipulate and share versions of their songs. Every time a fan shares their creation, the artist is automatically credited and their work is distributed more widely. Because Mixy owns the creation layer, attribution is native. We auto-credit every source track and pair it with a music-first social network built for playback and discovery.

The future isn’t millions of irrelevant AI songs, it’s millions of recognizable songs evolving through thousands of shared versions.

If we truly succeed, Mixy will be the platform that redefines music in the age of derivative works. What TikTok is to YouTube, Mixy is to Spotify.

We’re tackling this because we love music, see a timely problem, and bring a world-class background in creative tools and consumer social.

launches.title: Digipals - AI-native Group Chats that get you outside
launches.tagline: Where AI makes us more social
launches.body:
Social media has become more media and less social. When I open up Facebook and Instagram, I don’t see any of my friends on it anymore - it’s one third ads, one third content from strangers on the internet, and one third AI slop. My friends are no longer on social media - I either meet up with them IRL or catch up with them in group chats.

https://youtu.be/KW2tjLl6sxM 

What if your group chats could help get you a reservation... and help you split the bill? Now it can.

We're building an AI-native group chat app that helps you hang out with your friends more. Your AI agent (digipal) knows your location, calendar, relationship history, and photos. It talks with your friends' digipals to coordinate IRL hangouts automatically - suggesting times when everyone's free, finding nearby restaurants and coffee shops, making reservations with AI calls, splitting bills from receipts, and nudging you to share photo memories after hanging out. 

Right now, coordinating hangouts with friends takes too much effort. We're removing that friction so you can spend less time planning and more time actually having fun IRL.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7bae7c14-2266-4d71-82e2-f23716cf4f2a)

**Where We're Going - The First AI-Native Social Operating System**

Digipals work through AI widgets that pop up right in your group chat when you and your friends need them. Talking about dinner? The restaurant widget appears. Someone sends a receipt? The bill split widget shows up. You never have to leave the group chat to coordinate.

We're starting with widgets that make it easier to hang out IRL - restaurant reservations, movie/concert suggestions, flight/hotel bookings, bill splitting, and sports scores. Here's some sneak peeks:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/91296545-05f9-4057-b324-b600168547b9)

Then we're adding widgets that help you stay close to your friends and make new ones - relive memories from fun times together in the past, post memes/articles/reels your group would actually find funny, surface life updates worth celebrating, and connect with friends of friends.

Eventually, anyone can build AI widgets for Digipals. Your group chat becomes the social operating system, and the widgets are the apps that enhance human connection.

**Team**

[Peggy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/peggy-wang-ai/) cares deeply about human relationships. For over nine years, she's grabbed dinner monthly with the same friends at Madras Cafe in Sunnyvale - the restaurant their group chat is named after. She's a second time founder who worked on the Metaverse at Meta Reality Labs, where she believed that the future of social connection was in virtual worlds and games. Now, she's convinced the future is simpler - it's showing up IRL.

Mathew made a hit solo game called [deadshot.io](http://deadshot.io) which has over 2M+ monthly active users. He enjoys connecting with others through playing music and video games, and joined the team to help make the future a little less lonely for everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7ee11258-ded8-466d-a9e5-ac5819801ad0)

**Asks**

launches.body:
Hi everyone, I’m [Alon](https://x.com/alonzuman), founder of [Pops.](https://pops.fyi/)

Pops is the future of entertainment: AI-native, playful social experiences and games anyone can create, remix, and play with their friends. **Short-form software.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/77b75800-d1a4-4c0d-a32b-d2662e68f1fd)

With Pops, you can describe (almost) any idea you have and turn it into a fun, playable experience: a Flappy Bird-like game where you flap by raising your arms, a game where you blink to screw the bolt, or a 3D racing game controlled by your head movements. You don't need to code, just a fun idea.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/2a9308df-5961-4bd1-9571-b1518bf8020d)

And because Pops is meant to be social, every Pop you play instantly creates a video you can share. Usually the best part is not just the game itself, but the funny reaction video: you can brag about your score, send it back to the creator, or share it because it’s genuinely funny.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/2fda7e52-ea0d-46a7-846b-dec64807ee4b)

## **About me**

I’ve spent the past six years building creative tools, most recently at Playground AI, where the products I worked on were used by millions of people. Pops started as something broader, but a private beta made the direction obvious: AI-native games are the perfect format for social, playful creation, and one of the first places short-form software can become mainstream.

Pops is live on iOS and Android, and I’d love for you to try it out:

<https://pops.fyi>

## Ask

Play a few Pops! Make or remix your own Pop, and share it with your friends.

I’d love feedback on what feels magical and what’s confusing.
